verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requests Android app-size optimization and a lightweight application.
The client specifies remote hosting of heavy assets to reduce the application package size.
First concrete failure evidence: the assessed Android package was 89 MB and lacked size-reduction mechanisms.

value_updates.remote_asset_hosting_strategy: Host heavy non-tutorial graphic images remotely rather than include them in the application package.
value_updates.tutorial_asset_strategy: Use shared tutorial background images with translatable text instead of separate language-specific tutorial images.

verdicts.decision_note: The edit consolidates duplicate tutorial attributes and narrows the prior remote-hosting rule so it does not conflict with the new tutorial-image strategy.
The client identifies smallest possible app size and maximum language coverage as the remaining priorities.

value_updates.tutorial_asset_strategy: Use a YouTube video instead of tutorial images.

verdicts.decision_note: The source replaces the tutorial-image strategy with video; overwriting the consolidated strategy key avoids unsupported changes to other remotely hosted graphics.
First concrete verification: the built Android APK measured 27.4 MB after an approximately 73% reduction.
